article.title: Your AI Coding Agent Doesn’t Need Another Prompt. It Needs a Judge.

data.text: AI coding agents don’t just need better prompts. They need strong tests, deterministic verification and a clear PASS/FAIL loop. Better feedback can make even imperfect agents far more reliable. #AI #AIAgents #SoftwareEngineering https://t.co/d5MxXX6MRo
